name: fathom
description: Fathom an unfamiliar repository — to fathom is to deeply understand; the root is the nautical depth unit, measured line by line downward, the shape of this plugin's ladder. One skill: repo — climb Repository → Runtime → System → Behavior → Code. The opening scan anchors the pin (including its distance from the latest release), judges which levels collapse, lands a growing soundings.md anchor index, and delivers a measured trust verdict — how much to believe what you read here, closing with a read-it-like-this instruction. Then a calibration probe on the learner's background sets the gloss list, contrast anchor, and chapter compression before anything learner-facing is built. Per level: teach with knowledge-matched forms (interactive guided mockup at Repository — spatial map, run playback, claim expansion, classification tree, weighted graph with next-hints), dwell for the learner's questions, then a verbalization gate — the learner narrates their own model, the agent repairs only the exposed gap. Persistent study cursor resumes across sessions. Method evidence lives in the etudes lab. Language-agnostic.
